scope: Phase B statement/tool builds and completed prebaseline direct compiles; not the later theorem census or ledger-status runs.
event_timestamps: No timestamps inferred. Archive metadata normalized to zero only for reproducible packaging, not execution evidence.
serialization: Recorded runner runs one module at a time with LEAN_NUM_THREADS=1; no Lean process was started for packaging.
plan_caveat: Original serial-plan status and requested counts are planning fields, not execution evidence. Actual records below override no field in the retained original.
outer_exit_caveat: Null means unknown, never inferred from successful stdout or a compiler child exit.
